Photo 2: tin of Chinese modern cards, top card a reverse-holo Meloetta-type 70 HP card. Rest are modern Chinese promos and SV cards.
lots.condition: Cards look clean in sleeves from the photo; vintage commons look played to light play at this size. Pizza Hut sheets appear unpunched.
lots.question_for_gowans: How many cards are in the tin, and are the two Pizza Hut First Movie sheets complete and unpunched?
